notes: This sheet is drawn with north to the LEFT: W. McMillan runs down the left side, Ohio Av. across the top (slanting), W. Clifton Av. along the bottom, Moerlein across the middle. Printed names without suffix (LYON, MOERLEIN, RENSHAW, ATKINSON, BOSLEY, BALL) are written with 'Street'; W. McMILLAN is 'West McMillan Street' as on 249-251; OHIO AV. 'Ohio Avenue'; W. CLIFTON AV. 'West Clifton Avenue'. The short street printed BALL (30') between Renshaw and Atkinson is lettered BALD on the key map; the sheet spelling is used. Renshaw is printed 'RENSHAW (NOT OPENED)', 26'; it runs from Moerlein to Ball and forms an L corner with Ball's west end (both end there). Lyon (40') runs straight from Ohio across Moerlein (the street south of Moerlein carries no label on the sheet, but it is Lyon's straight continuation and the key map letters LYON on that side) to Clifton. HARTSHORN (written 'Hartshorn Street', ~50' as drawn) comes in from the west (sheet 260 margin) and ends at McMillan (McMillan's east line is unbroken; the double line leaving it there is the stone retaining wall). Moerlein (50') runs from McMillan (T) to the right edge (onto 242). Renshaw, Atkinson and Bosley start at Moerlein (north side continuous). The Ohio/McMillan corner is at the top-left, but Ohio's centreline there is off the top of the paper, so it is not recorded. Clifton's far (west) line is below the paper edge (paper ends ~y 7720; north line y~7430-7480); the three Clifton points use the printed 60' width (centre ~181 px below the north line), so they are less certain (+-20 px in y). Bosley runs down the right edge into the binding; its Clifton crossing (centre x~6540) is off the page. Clifton curves upward at the right (north line y~7475 at x 5000, ~7330 at x 6380). The dashed PRIVATE LANE in block 1 (Ohio side to Moerlein) and the stone retaining wall line in block 3 are not streets.
